Name | Symbols | Definition
:-------------- | ------ | ----------
[Probability density function (PDF)](#def-pdf) | $f(t), \p(t)$ | $\p(T=t)$
[Cumulative distribution function (CDF)](#def-cdf) | $F(t)$ | $\Pr(T\leq t)$
[Survival function](#def-surv-fn) | $\surv(t), \bar{F}(t)$ | $\Pr(T > t)$
[Hazard function](#def-hazard) | $\haz(t), \h(t)$ | $\p(T=t \mid T\ge t)$
[Cumulative hazard function](#def-cuhaz) | $\cuhaz(t), \H(t)$ | $\int_{u=-\infty}^t \haz(u)\,du$
Log-hazard function | $\loghaz(t)$ | $\logf{\haz(t)}$

: Probability distribution functions of a continuous random variable $T$ {#tbl-prob-dist-fns}
